title: Sikkim Tunnel Tragedy: PM Modi Announces Rs 2 Lakh Ex-Gratia For Kin of Deceased, Rs 50,000 For Injured
description: The Prime Minister also announced Rs 50,000 for those injured in the incident. "Anguished by the loss of lives due to the collapse of an under-construction tunnel in Namchi, Sikkim. I extend my deepest condolences to the bereaved families. I pray that those injured recover at the earliest."
